M12 — 2026-09-22
Run long perf harnesses on this laptop under `caffeinate -ims` (e.g. `caffeinate -ims npx vitest run --project perf`). If the Mac idle-sleeps mid-run, especially on battery overnight, the harness fails with `spawnSync ... ETIMEDOUT` at a random measure or inside prepare(). The 120 s spawn timeout counts wall-clock time, and that includes the sleep. The same spawns run directly take 1-4 s. Diagnose with `pmset -g log | grep -E 'Entering Sleep|DarkWake'` over the run's window. Found 2026-09-22 when two team100 A/B runs died this way (sleep at 23:56 and 23:58 for 1,050 s).
